name: NGC 1331 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 1331, a nearby early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc1331-hubble
story: Hubble looked into the heart of this quiet galaxy and found a dense cluster of stars packed at its center, part of a search for black holes that feed only faintly.

claims.text: NGC 1331 is a target of a Hubble survey of faint nearby spheroidal galaxies, to find nuclear star clusters and correct black hole X-ray measurements for them
NGC 1331 is an early-type galaxy in the AMUSE-Field sample and is nucleated
A nucleus here means a nuclear star cluster
